marta_cs: Hey team — Compass Health just emailed a packet: SOC2 attestation request, a DPA with a few change requests, and their vendor risk form. They want consolidated answers + evidence by EOD Friday. Can someone own collating artifacts?

james_csm: I can own the customer-facing Qs and the onboarding timeline. will pull the onboarding checklist + activation logs.

olivia_sec: I’ll take security evidence (SOC2 scope, control mappings, encrypt at rest details). tagging @kevin_engineer for KMS/encryption specifics.

kevin_engineer: ok. I can export KMS key policy, GCP/AWS resource list, and S3 bucket encryption settings. what format do they want — ZIP with csv or a table?

marta_cs: CSV is fine. also include a short narrative for each item (1–2 lines). Compass asked specifically about: key rotation cadence, HSM usage, cross-region backups, and who has key admin.

anna_legal: I’ll review the DPA redlines. quick heads-up: they added a clause about subcontractor audit rights — might need to limit scope.

olivia_sec: noted. I have the SOC2 report (PDF) but need to produce a control mapping doc that ties our controls to their vendor questions. draft mapping will live in Drive: https://drive.redwood.company/shared/compass-evidence (permission: compass-view).

james_csm: putting checklist here so we’re aligned:
```
- SOC2 report (pdf)
- Control mapping (xlsx)
- DPA redline summary (doc)
- Subprocessor list (csv)
- KMS/key rotation proof (csv + narrative)
- Data residency statement (short)
- Access audit logs (last 90 days)
```

marta_cs: timeline: today — evidence collection; tomorrow morning — legal & security signoff; tomorrow afternoon — assemble and send to Compass. if any blockers escalate ASAP.

onboarding-bot: Task created — COMPASS-QUESTIONNAIRE-2102509876 assigned to james_csm, olivia_sec. Due: 2026-03-26 17:00 UTC.

kevin_engineer: FYI backup region list attached (link): https://internal.storage/backup-regions.csv. I'll export key policies to the Drive folder in 30m.

olivia_sec: pulled the SOC2 and started the mapping. question for @anna_legal: for the subprocessor clause, can we propose a POA&M (plan of actions) instead of full audit access?

anna_legal: yes — propose a scoped POA&M + on-site audit only for material processors. I’ll draft language and post in Drive for review.

james_csm: client concern: renewal conversation tied to security posture. they said "we need to be sure no elevated risks before renewal" — might be a renewal risk if we miss timeline. flagging renewals team.

marta_cs: thanks. @olivia_sec please add a short risks section in the packet (2–3 bullets) so sales/renewals have context.

olivia_sec: will do. initial bullets: (1) subprocessor audit ask; (2) cross-region backup clarification; (3) missing last-90-days access logs for one service (working on it).

kevin_engineer: access logs: I can produce aggregated logs but need to redact internal service tokens. will note redaction in narrative.

marta_cs: perfect. once all items in Drive, I’ll assemble and send to Compass + cc renewals. everyone please drop a quick "done" when you upload. :thumbsup:

olivia_sec: uploaded SOC2 + initial mapping (Drive). done.

kevin_engineer: uploaded key policies + backup csv. done.

james_csm: uploaded onboarding logs and final Q/A sheet. done.

anna_legal: uploaded DPA redline + suggested response language. done.

marta_cs: awesome — on my way to assemble. will post final bundle and send at 17:00 UTC. thanks all. :rocket:

onboarding-bot: Reminder scheduled — send COMPASS bundle at 2102513400.
